subject: general
question: What is the full form of WCED (also known as Brundtland Commission) formed by the United Nations for sustainable development?

options.text: World Commission on Environment and Development

solution:
Correct answer is__** World Commission on Environment and Development.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The goal of the** Brundtland Commission** was to support** and direct the nations of the world toward the goal of sustainable development**.
 
• The commission is also called the **World Commission on Environment and Development (WCED). **
 
• It worked from **1984 to 1987**.
 
• The commission issued its outcomes in the **Brundtland report in 1987.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The UN's World Commission for Environment and Development, chaired by previous Norwegian Prime Minister **Gro Harlem Brundtland** and so mentioned to as the **Brundtland Commission, **published the report **“Our Common Future,” **also called the **“Brundtland Report,” in 1987.****​ **
 
• The Brundtland Commission was chaired by previous Norwegian prime minister** Gro Harlem Brundtland. Politicians, civil servants, and environmental experts made up the majority of the members. **
